namespace PubAV05
def isStrictInc3 : List Nat → Bool
  | [a, b, c] => (a < b) && (b < c)
  | _ => false
theorem vacuous_empty_nonempty : ¬ (∃ xs : List Nat, xs = [] ∧ xs.length > 0) := by sorry
theorem strictPair_nonvacuous (xs : List Nat) (h : isStrictInc3 xs = true) : ∃ a b c, xs = [a, b, c] ∧ a < c := by sorry
theorem strictInc3_witness : isStrictInc3 [2, 5, 9] = true := by sorry
end PubAV05
